required_receipts: complete payload or explicit page disposition
archive_policy.incorporation_rule: Analytical and canonical projections may consume only a named, content-addressed archived snapshot. Mutable live endpoints are acquisition inputs, not analytical evidence.
archive_policy.storage_boundary: Do not commit live GIS payloads, Parquet, GeoParquet, DuckDB or bulk archives to Git. Store manifests and bounded evidence in-repository; stage large payloads in the configured artifact/preservation workflow.
archive_policy.temporary_owner: edithatogo/riopa-infrastructure retains archive-plan ownership until the planned edithatogo/nz-spatial-archive repository is activated and a content-bound handover is approved.

related_repository_routing.role: Provider discovery, acquisition, raw snapshot manifests and RIOPA source/capture projections.
Existing NZ Gazette archive, publication staging, freshness and change evidence; no duplicate issue created.
Code-first facility contract adapter only. Licensed Healthpoint payloads are excluded from the public-only campaign and are not archive inputs.
Existing research-object and preservation adapter work may be reused after source-specific archives are complete; it does not own these datasets.

datasets.authority: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand
datasets.current_evidence: Metadata for layer 50772 is archived in WP-007; feature payload is not.
datasets.archive_action: Freeze the selected published version and source revision, run a bounded complete export, record every export/poll/download receipt and preserve the raw package by SHA-256.
datasets.non_claim: Parcel coverage is national geometry evidence, not population, network, facility or accessibility validity.

datasets.archive_action: Archive exact service metadata, schema and all paged features plus selected exact-edition public population/census tables before building denominator projections.
datasets.non_claim: Meshblocks define supporting geography; they do not supply destinations, travel times or causal evidence.

datasets.archive_action: Register the exact open-data service, freeze its schema/version/terms and preserve a complete content-addressed network snapshot before routing conversion.
datasets.non_claim: An archived network is not proof that every mode, restriction or route is complete or routable.

datasets.archive_action: Inventory public static and realtime feeds separately, preserve terms/service dates/feed bytes and health receipts per authority, and retain unavailable/private feeds as explicit dispositions.
datasets.non_claim: Regional feeds must not be represented as a complete national timetable.

datasets.archive_action: Select four materially different public mechanisms, then archive raw service capabilities, layers, plan documents, terms and legal-status evidence before canonical linkage.
datasets.non_claim: Archived plan material is evidence of publication and content, not legal interpretation.

datasets.authority: New Zealand Gazette and preserved secondary sources
datasets.archive_action: Consume only versioned Gazette archive manifests and freshness/change receipts produced by the existing corpus tracks.
datasets.non_claim: Gazette evidence does not alone establish the operative status or spatial extent of a planning provision.

datasets.authority: Public council registers and source-specific open contributors
datasets.archive_action: Archive source-specific council register and OpenStreetMap snapshots with terms, observation times and hashes before emitting immutable facility assertions.
datasets.non_claim: No single public source is authoritative or complete; disagreement and missingness remain visible.

datasets.authority: Verified public health agencies and public source assertions
datasets.archive_action: Retain the certified-provider snapshot and the separately archived Rangitīkei public ambulance reference packet before facility reconciliation.
datasets.excluded_source: Licensed Healthpoint payloads are excluded; healthpoint-rs issue 52 remains a data-light contract path only.
datasets.non_claim: OSM or public web assertions cannot be promoted to authoritative national ambulance coverage.
